run_ft_gemma3n_image_trl: run the script to fine-tune Gemma-3n vision-language model on datasets like intersection-dataset or LLaVA instruct
create_my_get_peft_config: create a PEFT LoRA config that handles comma-separated target modules for fine-tuning
